Severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy on MRI

s4.champion: Progressive Ataxia and Palatal Tremor (PAPT), sporadic type

raw.champion: Progressive Ataxia and Palatal Tremor (PAPT), sporadic type
raw.rationale: The patient's combination of progressive ataxia, palatal myoclonus, and severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy on MRI, along with the inability to stop myoclonus with voluntary muscle use, best matches the characteristics of Progressive Ataxia and Palatal Tremor (PAPT), sporadic type.

rejected.label: Sporadic Adult-Onset Ataxia (SAOA)
rejected.why: Lack of specific features distinguishing it from PAPT

rejected.label: Idiopathic late-onset cerebellar ataxia
rejected.why: Does not account for palatal myoclonus

rejected.label: Multiple System Atrophy
rejected.why: Not supported by the presence of palatal myoclonus and the pattern of atrophy

rejected.label: Olivopontocerebellar Atrophy
rejected.why: Genetic testing for related spinocerebellar ataxias was normal
